scope:
Single-server DNS search over real loopback TCP exchanges.

Checks DNS RCODE classification, selected-empty replies, search precedence,
alias follow-ups, refusal, EOF/reset/partial framing, shared deadline and
terminal source/validation/abort errors.
Each scenario runs through both the default wrapper and explicit request options.
This is not a server retry, OS configuration or full resolver test.
compiler_strategy: Previously isolated telescope-cache/GC experiment at build/bend-profiles/edns-answer-teles/bend2; no compiler/runtime installation or patch changed. Ordinary candidate address-search compilation retains the recorded memory limitation.
implementation_scope: Caller options carried through search context to each candidate lookup; existing search entry points supply defaults. Context now includes an options field. Tests use a fixed loopback server; configuration integration, rotating option-aware selectors and EDNS negotiation/fallback remain separate obligations.
